name: Mohammad Toaha
contribution: Mohammad Toaha was a left student activist who connected the Bengali language question with democratic and class politics.
context: He participated in the early language movement and was injured during the 1948 protest wave, while later political work kept him in the left opposition.
impact: His career resisted reducing the language struggle to culture alone, framing it also as a question of rights and social power.
